cardObtain: [Unidentified] Defeat this monster in Hollow Zero 1 time to obtain its data
cardSkillDesc: During the battle, Metamorphosed - Tepes frequently uses the spiked hammers in both hands to launch powerful attacks and inflict a damage reduction effect. Successfully executing Defensive Assists multiple times to block Tepes' hand attacks will Impair its spiked hammers. Once the hammers are Impaired, some of Tepes' moves will reveal significant openings, the damage reduction effect will be lost, and Tepes will be inflicted with an increased Daze Vulnerability.
name: Metamorphosed - Tepes
